name: IJN Hyūga
shortDescription: Tier V battleship with twelve 356mm guns across six turrets, only the front pair bears on the bow, the other four need a broadside.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 10s action, 80s cooldown, unlimited charges. Half New Mexico's 20s cycle, one of the quicker DCP resets on a tier IV-V battleship.

consumables.name: Repair Party
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 28s each at 304 hp/s, about 8,500 hp per activation and roughly 42% of her 60,700 hp pool across all three, in line with peers at this tier.

consumables.name: Main Battery Reload Booster
consumables.flavor: -50% main battery reload for 15s, 150s cooldown, 2 charges. Turns a 29s reload into roughly 14.5s for the window, good for one extra salvo mid-engagement. Not every battleship at this tier gets one.

consumables.name: Observation Seaplane
consumables.flavor: 30s duration, 200s reload, 3 charges, tightens shell groupings while active.

consumables.name: Enhanced Secondary Targeting
consumables.flavor: 30s window, 160s reload, 3 charges. Sharpens an already below-average secondary battery rather than turning a weak one into a real threat.

turrets.note: Amidships pair, needs a full broadside to bear, can't reach either the bow or stern arc.

strengths: Twelve 356mm guns across six turrets, longest main battery range of any tier IV-V battleship in this DB at 16.2 km
60,700 hull HP and armor the ship's own in-game notes call out as excellent, tanks small and mid-caliber fire well
25.3-knot top speed, the fastest battleship in this DB by a wide margin, enough to pick her own range and angle
Main Battery Reload Booster cuts reload by half for 15 seconds, a tool most battleships at this tier don't carry
13.8 km surface detectability is genuinely low for a battleship this size
weaknesses: Only turrets 1 and 2 bear on the bow, the other four need at least a partial broadside, so the full twelve-gun salvo still means committing to an angle
The amidships pair (turrets 3 and 4) is even more restricted, port and starboard only, needing a full broadside just to bear at all
Secondary battery and AA are both weaker than peers, neither covers an approach or a passing striker
750m turning radius and a 15s rudder shift make it slow to swing the broadside onto a new target once committed
tips: You can answer bow-in with turrets 1 and 2, but don't linger there, turn broadside as soon as you can to bring the other eight guns to bear
Save the Reload Booster for a target you're already angled on and expect to keep shooting at, not as an opener
Bow-in you're fighting with a third of your guns, don't mistake that partial fire for a real trade, turn broadside as soon as the approach allows
Use the speed to choose the fight rather than to chase, you can't recover from a bad angle once you're committed to one

threats.threat: Anything that can hold a position where she can't turn broadside in time
threats.reason: Bow-in she still answers with turrets 1 and 2, but the other eight guns can't bear until she turns broadside.

threats.threat: Destroyers and aircraft that close inside her weak AA and secondary coverage
threats.reason: Neither system is strong enough to meaningfully punish something that gets in close.

summary: Fast, well-armored battleship whose forward turrets can answer bow-on, but two-thirds of her main battery still needs a broadside to bear.
Twelve 356mm guns with more reach than any other battleship in this DB at tier IV-V.
A -50% reload booster gives her a burst window most peers at this tier don't have.
Weak secondaries and AA mean she has little to fall back on if she gets caught out of position.
playstyle.detail: Hyūga shares her hull with sister ship Ise, and the turret arrangement shows it: six twin mounts split fore, amidships, and aft. The front pair swings onto the bow like a normal battleship's, but the amidships and aft turrets are all restricted to the broadside, so a full twelve-gun salvo still means committing to an angle. In exchange she gets real speed for the tier, armor that holds up, a big hit point pool, and a reload booster that most battleships her tier don't carry. Play her patiently, lean on the front two guns while closing, then pick the moment to turn broadside and bring the other eight into the fight, the twelve-gun salvo backed by the longest range at this bracket is worth the wait.

goalTags.note: 60,700 hp and armor called out as excellent in her own in-game notes let her absorb punishment well once she's turned broadside.
